system.description:
At your touch a victim's skin blackens, rots and sloughs away in wet ribbons, the decay eating ever deeper with each successive strike.

Touch the victim and expend two Blood Traits; no roll to strike is needed against a willing or held target, though a resisting foe must be caught with a Physical Challenge retested with Occult. The subject immediately suffers one health level of lethal damage as the flesh rots off, and gains the Negative Traits Decrepit and Repugnant until the damage heals. Multiple strikes inflict additional damage and Negative Traits cumulatively, eventually reducing the victim to a pool of putrescent liquid.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
